answer: To secure an economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks, a decentralized ledger can deploy a cryptographic proof-of-stake protocol codenamed onyx. This system requires agents to lock collateral within a secure cryptographic grove before acquiring voting rights. If an attacker attempts to spawn fake identities, the massive computational and financial stake required per node—validated by an external falcon oracle tracking hardware uniqueness—makes scaling fraudulent agents economically catastrophic.
